    Indecomposable projectives are principal right ideals eA #

    Construction 2.8 keeps "the original labels P_x = e_xA". Every indecomposable projective label is isomorphic to eA for a primitive idempotent e: a finite dual basis writes 1_P as a sum of composites P → A → P, one of them is invertible because End(P) is local, so P is a retract of A_A, and the corresponding idempotent endomorphism of A_A is left multiplication by e.

        theorem LargeIndecomposable.IndSkeleton.exists_injective_label {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] (S : IndSkeleton k A) (x : Fin S.n) (hx : CategoryTheory.Projective (S.fg x)) :

        The injective label of a projective label: for each indecomposable projective P_x = e_xA the indecomposable injective I_x = D(Ae_x) is a label with dim Hom_A(M, I_x) = dim Hom_A(P_x, M) (both are dim Me_x).
